- **Charcoal Sketch** (`lumenary:charcoal-sketch`, models this process): Charcoal is a powder that sticks to the bumps of the paper and slides off the hollows, so whether a pixel turns black depends on the paper’s tooth as well as on the picture. A light touch catches only the peaks and shows grain, and a heavy one fills everything… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/charcoal-sketch.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/07-painterly.md`.
